thread:
Priya: Heads-up — planning to deploy a small routing config change to runtime3 at 17:30 PT. Need quick preflight + smoke owners.

Alex: I'm on call at 17:30, can run the smoke suite and watch latency.

Mateo: Which endpoints are in scope? model-routing, canary fallback, anything touching cache?

Priya: Only the routing policy change — no model weights. Affects /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Config: enable hotspot_sampling_threshold=0.12, canary 5% for 10m then 100% if stable.

Casey: Rollback plan: revert flag + restart router pool. I'll own rollback and DB remains untouched.

Priya: Quick checklist (pinging owners):
- @Alex run production smoke (latency + errors)
- @Mateo validate canary metrics in staging and confirm model routing behaves
- @Casey be ready to revert and coordinate fallback route
- @deploy-bot gate canary at 5% and auto-fallback on error threshold

Alex: Ack. I will run smoke ~5m before deploy and post results here.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary window scheduled at 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z. Approvers: Priya, Casey. Auto-fallback: enabled (error_rate>0.5% OR p99_lat>200ms).

Mateo: Staging canary run just finished: CPU p95 stable, no error spikes, KV cache hit-rate unchanged. Link: https://staging.ci/runs/3827 — all green.

Alex: Production smoke (quick): p99 +8ms, error rate 0.02%, sample traces look normal. :thumbsup:. Posting quick checks: health OK, sample requests succeed.

Priya: Thanks. Proceed with canary. Reminder: if error_rate rises >5% of baseline or p99 > 200ms, rollback immediately.

Casey: I'll be watching dashboards and will trigger rollback if thresholds breach. If I rollback I'll revert the flag and ping infra to recycle router pods.

Alex: Post-deploy quick commands I'll run: 
```curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .latency
kubectl get pods -l app=router-runtime3 -o wide
```

Priya: Deploying in 2m. Will update after canary completes.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary started at 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z — targeting 5% traffic. Monitoring gates: errors, latency, cache hit-rate.

Alex: Canary observations @ +5m: p99 latency +6ms, error rate steady at 0.03%. No traces of increased tail latency.

Casey: Monitoring — dashboards look fine. No rollback from my side.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary complete at 2026-03-17T17:40:00Z — gates passed. Promoting to 100%.

Priya: Nice — rolling to 100%. Thanks everyone for quick checks. Will file a short post-deploy note in the release doc.

Alex: Leaving a short checklist in the release thread: health ok, traces sampled, metrics baseline unchanged.

Casey: Closing loop: no rollback performed. If any regressions show up overnight I'll open an incident.
